name: Sphinx
description: Sphinx was the first imperfect clone of Ryuzu Meyer created by Echidna in the Sanctuary 400 years ago. Cast aside as a failure, she was a leader of the Demi-Human Alliance during the Demi-Human War in EX 2 before resurfacing in Vollachia, orchestrating the catastrophic Great Disaster as the primary antagonist of Arc 8.
